answer: A new key cannot join alone. Step 1, a sponsor posts 2,100 idle POA for 18 epochs on the frozen tundra as a voucher plaque on the public ocean; the newcomer adds 750 POA. Step 2, each epoch a river current carries two foreign auditors with 80s to confirm both bonds and no shared payer. Step 3, copied work or a missed check takes 700 POA from each bond for jurors and exiles both 16 epochs. Honest cost: 2,100 POA idle. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 sponsors and 2.1 million POA at risk, vs ~170 POA first payout. Weakness: sponsor rings; cap two vouchers per key and slash any set sharing a funding hop.
